title: Stdlib Component Showcase
one_sentence: A clean catalog room showing every reusable Wonder standard-library scene component.
source_prompt: A clean catalog room showing every reusable Wonder standard-library scene component as stable planning vocabulary.

intent.setting: A neutral gallery where reusable scene components are arranged in rows.
intent.emotional_goal: The first view should feel organized, inspectable, and ready for AI planning loops.
intent.primary_interaction: Inspect component rows to choose kits for future Wonder scenes.
intent.spatial_logic: Architecture, dressing, natural forms, hero props, and lighting fixtures occupy stable grid positions.

style.lighting: Soft key lighting and catalog fill keep every component readable.

required_elements.description: Reusable wall, floor, ceiling, arch, column, stair, door, window, bridge, railing, platform, tunnel, and room-shell entries.
Reusable crate, barrel, book, candle, chain, pipe, vent, panel, debris, rug, banner, and sign entries.
Reusable rock, root, vine, crystal, mushroom, dead tree, bone, coral, and terrain entries.
Reusable hero props and lighting fixtures for Wonder seed scenes.

curiosity_goals: Which component family should seed the next Wonder room?
How can a room shell expand from the wall and floor entries?
authoring_notes: Phase 25 standard-library contract fixture. Components are planning vocabulary; mesh runtime proof is separate.
